newsitem.title: CANADA: Sask Wheat Pool to build elevator.
newsitem.headline: Sask Wheat Pool to build elevator.

text.p: Saskatchewan Wheat Pool, Canada's largest grain handler, said on Friday that it and 429 farmer-investors plan to begin construction of a 20,000-tonne high through-put elevator in this southwestern Saskatchewan town.
SWP will own 48 percent of the facility, which will also have 10,000 tonnes of condominium storage, with the Great Sandhills Terminal farmers' group owning the rest.

The concrete elevator will have the capacity to load 56 hopper cars on two loading tracks. The investment is part of SWP's three-year plan to spend C$235 million on new elevator facilities. Such elevators usually take a year to build.
